The iron features a dark, textured body (possibly Bakelite or hard plastic) with a metallic gold/brass trim along the edge. A black power cord with a two-prong plug is visible in the lower left foreground. The soleplate is not directly visible as the image shows the side/top profile.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The electrical plug is structurally nonsensical. The prongs appear fused into a loop or ring rather than two distinct parallel pins, and the connection to the wire is melted/indistinct. This is a classic AI generation failure on small, rigid mechanical details.
The texture on the dark body is slightly uniform and 'noisy' rather than showing specific material grain (like Bakelite cracks or plastic mold lines), though this is minor.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is classified correctly as an iron and not a similar household appliance.
To rigorously inspect the structural integrity of the plug, which showed signs of melting/fusion in initial scan.
To check for edge bleeding between the iron and the white background, and ensure the body is a single continuous manifold.
To verify the spatial relationship between the cord and the iron body (occlusion correctness).

focus_areas: Structural validity of the electrical plug (prong count and shape)
Edge sharpness between iron body and background
Consistency of lighting reflections on the metallic trim
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'structural_collapse' artifact noted in the power cord. Even if the main body of the iron is high quality, a nonsensical plug is a significant geometric failure. Verify if the classifier ignores this defect when identifying the class.
